findings.title: Re-entering during a pending action can leave stale inbox state
findings.why_it_matters: After tapping 全部已读, a user can return to 我的 and reopen the inbox before the POST finishes. The new list request may read the old unread state; when the POST later succeeds, its callback is discarded by the generation check, so the inbox keeps showing unread messages and count until another refresh. The same sequence after acknowledging or closing a family event can leave its old action button visible. Keep mutation completion separate from render cancellation and refresh the current page when an older mutation settles.
findings.suggested_fix: Track in-flight read-all and family-event mutation promises independently of page generation. On page show, wait for a pending mutation before loading, or trigger a fresh load after that mutation settles if the page is visible; preserve generation checks for stale response rendering.
